head: codex/5826-birthday-identity
title: [v0.92][WP-09] Stable name and identity architecture
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5826

## Summary
- bind stable-name and identity-root construction to signed identity-memory continuity and governed private-state projection evidence
- make runtime trust-policy establishment crate-private so external callers cannot nominate self-consistent attacker roots
- retain deterministic canonical records plus fail-closed signer, generation, provenance, continuity, projection, privacy, tamper, and path checks

## Validation
- internal Birthday authority lane: 7/7 passed
- external policy-establishment compile-fail proof: passed
- strict Clippy, formatting, Ruby receipt contracts, typed validation, and diff hygiene: passed
- native run 31365422176: macOS 7/7, Linux 7/7, identical eight-file manifests and semantic SHA-256 58a1781628b128f2c0ea811c5c1c8146b042523eee28db2a0a4d590a404bb71e; independent aggregator passed

## Review
Fresh independent exact-head security/privacy review by /root/review_5826_sealed_authority approved the sealed authority boundary and corrected typed ownership/planning scope with no actionable findings. This PR does not claim downstream continuity or Birthday completion.
